source.name: AgentFactory Autonomous Mission Mode implementation specification
source.status_note: PROPOSED describes this requirements manifest, not current implementation status. Stable IDs are retained; active product delivery order is docs/game-creator-backlog.uk.md and current evidence is docs/product-audit-2026-09-05.uk.md.

planning_contract.feature_representation: This legacy schema-v1 manifest retains kind=story with label level:feature for compatibility. The current importer supports first-class kind=feature in schema v2; new product manifests use schema v2.
planning_contract.execution_rule: Only kind=task items are executable. Epic and feature items are progress containers.
planning_contract.completion_claim: No item in this manifest is implemented merely because it is present. Completion requires the listed evidence and repository audit.

items.title: Durable mission domain and autonomous authority
items.description: Extend the existing AgentFactory domain with opt-in Autonomous Mission state, immutable revisions, epochs, checkpoints, and bounded local authorization.
acceptance_criteria: The autonomous domain is durable, versioned, audited, and migrates existing databases without changing standard behavior.
Mission approval authorizes only an exact local execution scope.
validation_method: Migration, state-machine, authorization, and compatibility test suites.
definition_of_done: AF-AMM-001 through AF-AMM-006 pass with negative standard-mode and remote-provider tests.

items.title: Mission lifecycle and backlog revisions
items.description: Represent the mission lifecycle and active immutable backlog revision without creating a second project-management system.
acceptance_criteria: Mission phase and runtime disposition are independently resumable.
Historical backlog revisions remain immutable and queryable.
validation_method: Domain transition and revision replay tests.
definition_of_done: AF-AMM-001 and AF-AMM-002 are accepted.

items.title: Execution epochs, checkpoints, and local authorization
items.description: Bind every autonomous execution to a revision, epoch, reconstructible checkpoint, local provider set, and allowed tool profile.
acceptance_criteria: Epoch and checkpoint history is append-only.
Autonomous authorization cannot be consumed by a remote provider or standard run.
definition_of_done: AF-AMM-003 through AF-AMM-006 are accepted.

items.title: Agent planning and the single approval boundary
items.description: Turn a natural-language specification into a reviewed architecture and executable backlog, then stop before autonomous development until exact human approval.
acceptance_criteria: No backlog exists at mission creation.
Planning roles generate and verify a structured dependency-aware proposal.
Development cannot start before exact backlog approval.
validation_method: Planning fixture, malformed-output, dependency-order, and approval-boundary tests.
definition_of_done: AF-AMM-007 through AF-AMM-011 demonstrate the pre-approval flow end to end.

items.title: Specification analysis and planning roles
items.description: Reuse mission intake, role contracts, routing, context packages, and Blueprints to produce typed planning outputs from fresh local role contexts.
acceptance_criteria: Analyst, architect, planner, and reviewer outputs use explicit schemas.
Infrastructure prerequisites precede dependent application work.
validation_method: Golden planning fixtures and schema rejection tests.
definition_of_done: AF-AMM-007 through AF-AMM-010 are accepted.

items.title: Backlog approval and revision authority
items.description: Create the exact human boundary that activates Autonomous Local execution and governs later material revisions.
acceptance_criteria: Approval records mission, revision, digest, actor, and timestamp.
Human and agent-generated revisions follow distinct authorization paths.
validation_method: Digest mismatch, actor, idempotency, and revision-origin tests.
definition_of_done: AF-AMM-011 is accepted.

items.title: Long-lived Temporal mission orchestration
items.description: Add AutonomousMissionWorkflow as the durable project-level parent while preserving AgentFactoryJobWorkflow for standard and child work-item execution.
acceptance_criteria: Signals, child work, retries, recovery, and continue-as-new remain deterministic and durable.
The logical mission survives Worker and Temporal restarts for an unbounded sequence of workflow runs.
validation_method: Temporal time-skipping, replay, Worker restart, and real Compose restart tests.
definition_of_done: AF-AMM-012 through AF-AMM-018 are accepted without regressing AgentFactoryJobWorkflow.

items.title: Parent workflow and child work-item orchestration
items.description: Model pre-approval and post-approval phases and reuse existing work-item orchestration behind an opt-in mission context.
acceptance_criteria: The parent waits durably for approval.
Each ready item has an idempotent child workflow identity and durable result.
validation_method: Workflow contract and child replay tests.
definition_of_done: AF-AMM-012 through AF-AMM-014 are accepted.

items.title: Mission controls, history rollover, and recovery
items.description: Implement safe mission-wide controls, append-only restart semantics, bounded Workflow history, and deterministic recovery.
acceptance_criteria: Pause, resume, stop, retry, restart, and revision Signals are idempotent.
Continue-as-new preserves logical state and replay compatibility.
validation_method: Signal race, cancellation-boundary, continue-as-new, and recovery tests.
definition_of_done: AF-AMM-015 through AF-AMM-018 are accepted.

items.title: Git epochs and reconstructible checkpoints
items.description: Preserve every execution approach while allowing restart from an immutable checkpoint without destructive reset of project history.
acceptance_criteria: Every epoch has a deterministic AgentFactory-owned branch/worktree.
Restart from any valid checkpoint creates a new epoch and leaves later history available.
validation_method: Real Git worktree, dirty-state, divergence, restart, and supersession tests.
definition_of_done: AF-AMM-019 through AF-AMM-022 are accepted with no reset of main or prior epoch branches.

items.title: Mission epoch Git topology
items.description: Extend managed worktrees from task/lease identity to mission epoch and item integration authority.
acceptance_criteria: Epoch branches use stable collision-safe names.
Accepted item commits integrate only into the active epoch branch.
validation_method: Git topology and fenced ownership tests.
definition_of_done: AF-AMM-019 and AF-AMM-020 are accepted.

items.title: Checkpoint restart and backlog-change restart
items.description: Materialize complete checkpoint state and derive new epochs from selected commits and backlog revisions.
acceptance_criteria: Checkpoint integrity is verified before restart.
Revision impact and superseded history are persisted.
validation_method: Checkpoint corruption, historical restart, and revision impact tests.
definition_of_done: AF-AMM-021 and AF-AMM-022 are accepted.

items.title: Local model execution and one-GPU scheduling
items.description: Run all mission roles through qualified local providers, sequentially by default, with controlled writable tools and explicit review independence evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Only providers marked LOCAL consume autonomous authorization.
One durable lane serializes model inference across missions.
A single installed model can perform all roles using isolated contexts.
validation_method: Provider capability, scheduler concurrency/recovery, tool-runtime, and review-isolation tests.
definition_of_done: AF-AMM-023 through AF-AMM-029 are accepted.

items.title: Local provider inventory, scheduler, and writable runtime
items.description: Discover installed models, choose a role model, acquire a durable inference lease, and execute structured local tool turns.
acceptance_criteria: Model selection is dynamic and allowlisted.
Local tool mutation stays inside the mission worktree and policy.
validation_method: Fake-provider contract tests plus optional Ollama smoke tests.
definition_of_done: AF-AMM-023 through AF-AMM-026 are accepted.

items.title: Isolated role context, review independence, and telemetry
items.description: Build a fresh bounded execution package for each role and retain accurate independence and usage evidence without authorization budgets.
acceptance_criteria: No mission-wide conversation is reused.
Same-model review is labeled LOGICALLY_INDEPENDENT.
Cost and tokens are observed but do not block Autonomous Local work.
validation_method: Context digest, transcript isolation, review routing, and telemetry tests.
definition_of_done: AF-AMM-027 through AF-AMM-029 are accepted.

items.title: Autonomous environment bootstrap and service recovery
items.description: Discover the host and project requirements, converge an approved environment plan idempotently, and recover required services after interruption.
acceptance_criteria: Current and required environments are machine-readable and versioned.
Every install/service action is verified and evidenced.
Non-interactive blockers become NEEDS_HUMAN_ACTION.
validation_method: Hermetic plan fixtures, command fakes, container health tests, and Windows recovery smoke tests.
definition_of_done: AF-AMM-030 through AF-AMM-034 are accepted.

items.title: Discovery, manifests, and bootstrap execution
items.description: Create a required-vs-current plan and execute only typed, authorized, idempotent environment operations.
acceptance_criteria: Discovery includes hardware, tools, models, dependencies, services, ports, and health.
Healthy components are not reinstalled.
validation_method: Inventory fixtures and replay-safe bootstrap tests.
definition_of_done: AF-AMM-030 through AF-AMM-032 are accepted.

items.title: Health convergence and local long-run profile
items.description: Reconcile services after restart and document/support safe startup of the orchestration prerequisites on Windows.
acceptance_criteria: Required project services recover before development resumes.
Temporal volumes are never reset by normal startup.
validation_method: Service fault injection and reboot/startup profile tests.
definition_of_done: AF-AMM-033 and AF-AMM-034 are accepted.

items.title: Autonomous engineering, recovery, and completion loop
items.description: Select ready work, implement through controlled tools, validate and review, repair or replan failures, integrate accepted commits, checkpoint, and continue to final completion.
acceptance_criteria: Only dependency-ready active-revision tasks execute.
Accepted work has deterministic evidence, independent review evidence, an epoch commit, and a checkpoint.
Repeated failures exhaust autonomous alternatives before human attention.
validation_method: Coding-loop integration, failure-strategy, dynamic-subtask, ADR, and final-validation tests.
definition_of_done: AF-AMM-035 through AF-AMM-040 are accepted.

items.title: Ready-item execution and accepted progress
items.description: Reuse the existing coding-delivery substrate for autonomous child jobs and persist accepted progress after every item.
acceptance_criteria: Technical subtasks may be added without material scope change.
Validation and review gate every integration commit.
validation_method: Multi-item dependency and repair integration tests.
definition_of_done: AF-AMM-035, AF-AMM-036, and AF-AMM-039 are accepted.

items.title: Failure strategy, architecture evolution, and final validation
items.description: Escalate autonomously through distinct strategies, evolve implementation architecture within scope, and complete only from accepted evidence.
acceptance_criteria: The same failed strategy cannot retry forever.
Material product-scope changes create an unapproved proposed revision.
Completion requires all active items and final validation to pass.
validation_method: Strategy exhaustion, scope classification, ADR, and final-gate tests.
definition_of_done: AF-AMM-037, AF-AMM-038, and AF-AMM-040 are accepted.

items.title: Application services, REST, CLI, and Local Control Center
items.description: Expose one consistent Autonomous Mission product surface with persisted status, backlog, checkpoints, environment, and activity evidence.
acceptance_criteria: UI and CLI invoke the same application services.
Commands are authenticated/idempotent/audited and reads project the active revision and epoch.
Mission activity is derived from persisted evidence.
validation_method: Application/CLI parity, REST contract, accessibility, and Control Center end-to-end tests.
definition_of_done: AF-AMM-041 through AF-AMM-045 are accepted.

items.title: Shared application, REST, and CLI contracts
items.description: Add typed mission commands/read models once and expose them consistently through existing transports.
acceptance_criteria: REST and CLI observe identical domain transitions and audit events.
Concurrent edits use expected revision/epoch versions.
validation_method: Transport parity, ETag, actor, and idempotency tests.
definition_of_done: AF-AMM-041 through AF-AMM-043 are accepted.

items.title: Autonomous Missions Control Center
items.description: Add planning, approval, status, controls, editable backlog, checkpoint timeline, architecture, environment, logs, and agent activity views.
acceptance_criteria: Pre-approval and running mission views expose the fields and controls in the specification.
Restart actions clearly preserve later history and create a new epoch.
validation_method: DOM contract, accessibility, persisted-data, and browser workflow tests.
definition_of_done: AF-AMM-044 and AF-AMM-045 are accepted.

items.title: Compatibility, durability, and release qualification
items.description: Prove the complete Autonomous Mission scenario while preserving every standard AgentFactory control and surviving long-running local faults.
acceptance_criteria: The full specification scenario reaches COMPLETED with complete evidence.
Crashes and restarts do not lose or duplicate accepted work.
Standard mode remains behaviorally compatible.
validation_method: Full unit suite, Temporal integration, real local-provider smoke, fault injection, soak, and operator acceptance.
definition_of_done: AF-AMM-046 through AF-AMM-048 are accepted and all release gates in the review pass.

items.title: Automated compatibility and end-to-end qualification
items.description: Cover migrations, authorization isolation, Temporal controls, local scheduling, bootstrap, engineering, and operator transports with deterministic and real integration evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Negative tests prove no standard or remote-provider gate bypass.
The end-to-end mission completes with a fake local runtime and has an opt-in Ollama smoke path.
validation_method: Unit, contract, integration, and end-to-end test suites.
definition_of_done: AF-AMM-046 and AF-AMM-047 are accepted.

items.title: Long-run operations and release evidence
items.description: Qualify resource growth, restart recovery, startup profiles, upgrades, and operator documentation before release.
acceptance_criteria: Fault/soak evidence covers required restart classes and bounded growth.
Upgrade and rollback preserve active mission authority and history.
validation_method: Accelerated fault matrix, opt-in soak, and clean-host runbook exercise.
definition_of_done: AF-AMM-048 is accepted.

items.title: Autonomous Mission aggregate, configuration, and lifecycle migration
items.description: Add an opt-in mission aggregate that references the existing project/intake/Blueprint entities and stores phase, runtime disposition, active revision, active epoch, checkpoint, configuration, and optimistic version.
acceptance_criteria: Phase and runtime disposition use explicit checked transitions and PAUSED/STOPPED remain resumable.
Mission creation produces a DRAFT project container with specification metadata but no implementation backlog item.
Existing databases migrate forward without changing standard projects, runs, gates, or deterministic demo behavior.
Every transition records actor/command correlation and an audit event.
definition_of_done: All states and invalid transitions are tested.
A pre-migration database upgrades with unchanged standard records and valid audit continuity.
review_notes: Do not overload bootstrapped_missions.status='ready'; preserve that immutable bootstrap evidence and add a first-class autonomous aggregate.

items.title: Rich backlog schema, immutable revisions, and impact projection
items.description: Extend the typed backlog with Epic/Feature/Task hierarchy, execution fields, immutable revision snapshots, origins, active-revision projection, and completed-work impact classification.
acceptance_criteria: Every executable task contains priority, dependencies, acceptance criteria, validation method, components, infrastructure, artifacts, role, and Definition of Done.
Revisions are append-only, digest-bound, and identify HUMAN, AGENT_MATERIAL, or TECHNICAL_SUBTASK origin.
Impact analysis deterministically emits VALID, STALE, PARTIALLY_AFFECTED, REMOVED, or NEW for stable item IDs.
Mission progress uses only the active revision and preserves historical statuses/evidence.
expected_artifacts: Backlog schema v2 with v1 compatibility
definition_of_done: Existing v1 backlog files still validate/import.
A completed item invalidated by a revision becomes executable without overwriting its prior evidence.
review_notes: Use kind=story/level:feature only as a compatibility bridge; the runtime model should expose Feature explicitly.

items.title: Mission Execution Epoch and supersession model
items.description: Create append-only execution epochs rooted at a selected checkpoint, with active-epoch selection and non-destructive supersession projections.
acceptance_criteria: Epoch 1 is created exactly once when execution starts and later epochs reference a valid base checkpoint.
Only one epoch is active per mission under optimistic concurrency.
Later work/checkpoints from a prior epoch remain queryable and are marked superseded rather than deleted.
Epoch identity, base revision, base commit, and Temporal run-chain metadata are immutable.
definition_of_done: Historical epoch state can be reconstructed after multiple restarts and revisions.

items.title: Typed mission checkpoint model and integrity contract
items.description: Persist immutable reconstructible checkpoints with canonical state, Git authority, revision/epoch identity, manifests, roles, artifacts, memory references, services, and validation state.
acceptance_criteria: Checkpoint schema contains every minimum field in specification section 6 and a reason/type.
Canonical digest covers the complete checkpoint document and referenced artifact digests.
Code checkpoints require a resolvable committed Git SHA and never designate a dirty worktree as authoritative.
Checkpoint history is immutable and chronological per mission/epoch.
definition_of_done: A stored checkpoint round-trips to the exact canonical document and fails closed after any referenced-state mismatch.
review_notes: Keep existing stage_checkpoints and mission_initial_checkpoints as lower-level evidence; do not reinterpret them as full mission checkpoints.

items.title: Autonomous authorization resolver and revocation
items.description: Resolve standard one-use approval, bounded pre-approval local planning, and approved Autonomous Local execution without weakening any existing gate.
acceptance_criteria: AUTONOMOUS_LOCAL authority binds mission, approved revision/digest, policy, local provider set, role/model manifest, repository, epoch branch, and tool/bootstrap profiles.
An explicit human analyze/regenerate command grants only a bounded read-only local planning request before backlog approval; it grants no development or mutation authority.
STOPPED preserves authority; explicit revocation, policy drift, or unapproved agent material revision invalidates it.
STANDARD_GATED calls, remote providers, external mutations, protected integration, and unrelated missions still require their existing gates.
definition_of_done: No existing gate path contains a global bypass flag.
Every autonomous provider/tool decision records its derived authorization evidence.
review_notes: The specification needs local LLM calls to generate a backlog before approval; scope that planning authority to the explicit human command and read-only outputs.

items.title: Provider execution-location and local capability model
items.description: Add explicit provider capabilities for inference location, model inventory, dynamic model selection, tools, lifecycle control, and autonomous eligibility.
acceptance_criteria: Every provider declares LOCAL or REMOTE; missing location fails closed for autonomous eligibility.
Provider identity/name cannot imply locality.
Capabilities distinguish text generation, structured output, tool calls, model listing, model switching, and load/release support.
Existing provider configuration loads compatibly with an explicit safe migration/default and standard execution remains gated.
validation_method: Remote masquerade and missing-field negative tests
definition_of_done: Autonomous authorization can be evaluated provider-neutrally and Ollama is configured as LOCAL without hardcoding its name in mission policy.

items.title: Autonomous mission specification intake and source artifact
items.description: Create/update a mission specification through existing intake/source authority while preserving the requirement that no implementation backlog exists initially.
acceptance_criteria: Text and supported uploads become immutable source artifacts with digest, provenance, actor, and version.
A project shell may satisfy existing intake ownership but no executable backlog item is created before generation/approval.
Specification changes before approval create a new source version and invalidate stale proposals deterministically.
Unsafe or unreadable uploads fail without executing content.
definition_of_done: A DRAFT mission can be created and queried with its exact specification while work_items remains free of generated implementation tasks.

items.title: Autonomous planning role pack and role-to-model manifest
items.description: Define Mission Analyst, Product/Requirements Analyst, Software Architect, Backlog Planner, and Backlog Reviewer logical contracts with single- and multi-model assignments.
acceptance_criteria: Each role has typed inputs/outputs/evidence, tools, permissions, limits, and incompatible duties.
A default model or per-role installed local model can satisfy every assignment.
Planning roles receive fresh bounded contexts and read-only tool authority.
The manifest and digest are persisted per proposal/revision.
definition_of_done: One installed local model can fill all logical planning roles without sharing a conversation/session.

items.title: Structured multi-role architecture and backlog generation pipeline
items.description: Invoke the configured planning roles sequentially through local providers and persist typed intermediate/final proposal evidence.
acceptance_criteria: The pipeline produces normalized requirements, architecture proposal, rich backlog revision, dependencies, and role assignments.
Infrastructure/bootstrap tasks precede dependent development tasks when required.
Each role output is schema-validated and content-addressed before the next role consumes it.
Regeneration creates a new proposal rather than overwriting prior output.
definition_of_done: A natural-language fixture yields a valid dependency-aware backlog without manual decomposition and remains in a non-executable proposed state.
review_notes: Keep current deterministic analyzer as a safe fallback/input normalizer, not as proof of LLM planning.

items.title: Deterministic backlog and architecture proposal verifier
items.description: Validate planner output for schema completeness, traceability, cycles, readiness, scope, infrastructure order, acceptance measurability, and review evidence before presentation.
acceptance_criteria: Malformed, cyclic, orphaned, duplicated, non-measurable, or scope-untraceable items cannot become approvable.
Every executable task has all rich backlog fields and a deterministic logical order.
Backlog Reviewer findings are retained and resolved or explicitly displayed.
The exact canonical digest shown to the human is the digest later approved.
definition_of_done: Only a complete verified proposal can transition the mission to WAITING_FOR_BACKLOG_APPROVAL.

items.title: Approve Backlog - Start Mission and revision authority service
items.description: Create the exact approval/start transaction and distinguish human-applied, technical-subtask, and material agent revision behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Approval atomically records mission, revision, digest, timestamp, authenticated actor, policy/tool/model manifests, and autonomous authorization.
Digest/revision mismatch, stale actor version, duplicate conflicting approval, or unverified proposal fails closed.
Human-applied revisions are authorized at apply time; material agent revisions return to approval wait; technical subtasks stay traceable to an approved item.
No environment or development operation begins before the approval transaction commits.
definition_of_done: One human action activates the exact approved local mission and no later normal local invocation asks for a provider gate.

items.title: AutonomousMissionWorkflow contracts, queries, client, and Worker registration
items.description: Add typed parent Workflow input/carry-over/state, stable workflow identity, status/progress/current-role/environment queries, client operations, and Worker registration.
acceptance_criteria: AutonomousMissionWorkflow is additive and AgentFactoryJobWorkflow remains registered and behaviorally compatible.
Workflow state contains identifiers and bounded summaries only, with separate phase/disposition.
Stable logical workflow ID and query results expose revision, epoch, checkpoint, task, role/model, progress, and last activity.
Client start is idempotent and correlates Temporal run-chain metadata to the domain mission.
definition_of_done: A DRAFT mission starts or attaches to one stable parent Workflow and can be queried without loading large domain payloads into history.

items.title: Pre-approval analysis/generation phases and durable approval wait
items.description: Orchestrate specification analysis, planning roles, proposal verification, and a durable wait that cannot fall through into autonomous work without exact approval.
acceptance_criteria: Workflow transitions through analysis and generation to WAITING_FOR_BACKLOG_APPROVAL using idempotent Activities.
Planning calls use only the bounded read-only planning authorization from the explicit human request.
Approval is revalidated from persisted domain state rather than trusting Signal payload content.
Regeneration creates and presents a new proposal while preserving earlier proposals.
definition_of_done: The parent Workflow remains durably waiting and schedules no environment/development Activity until the approved revision is authoritative.

items.title: Post-approval phase and child work-item orchestration
items.description: Orchestrate environment phases, select one ready active-revision task, run it through an idempotent child AgentFactoryJobWorkflow context, integrate/checkpoint, and repeat.
acceptance_criteria: Each work item receives a deterministic child workflow ID scoped to mission/revision/epoch/item/logical attempt.
Child success is accepted only after persisted validation/review/integration evidence; duplicate child start is harmless.
Standard child behavior remains gated, while autonomous child mode resolves mission authorization and does not create a per-item Founder gate.
Parent schedules no next item until the previous item result and checkpoint are committed.
validation_method: Parent crash between child result and checkpoint
definition_of_done: A parent Workflow completes two dependent fake-provider items once each and creates a checkpoint after each.
review_notes: Reusing AgentFactoryJobWorkflow requires an opt-in autonomous path through the real coding-delivery substrate, not merely advisory provider artifacts.

items.title: Mission-wide pause, resume, stop, and retry control fence
items.description: Implement idempotent Signals and a durable fence checked before every inference, command, installation, service operation, and next work item.
acceptance_criteria: Pause lets the current atomic operation finish, blocks all new operations, propagates to active child execution, and records PAUSED without losing phase.
Stop converges to a safe boundary, releases active execution/inference leases, records STOPPED, and remains continuable from the latest valid checkpoint.
Resume/continue rejects stale fencing tokens and does not repeat accepted committed work.
retry_current_task creates a new logical strategy attempt with an idempotent command ID and does not replay a completed item.
validation_method: Signal race tests at every operation boundary
definition_of_done: No new inference or command starts after the persisted pause/stop fence, including inside a multi-tool local worker Activity.
review_notes: Do not map stop to the current terminal cancel/failed transition.

items.title: Checkpoint restart and backlog-revision Signal contracts
items.description: Add restart_from_checkpoint and apply_backlog_revision Signals with typed command IDs, expected state, selected checkpoint, and persisted epoch handoff.
acceptance_criteria: Signal payloads never directly authorize a revision or checkpoint; Activities revalidate the persisted actor-approved domain command.
An active child reaches/cancels at a safe boundary before epoch replacement.
New epoch/revision/checkpoint identity is carried into the next logical execution without rewriting history.
Duplicate and stale commands return the original result or a deterministic conflict.
definition_of_done: A selected approved checkpoint/revision produces exactly one new epoch and the parent resumes from its persisted handoff state.

items.title: Continue-as-new, history thresholds, visibility, and Worker versioning
items.description: Bound parent Workflow history at safe checkpoints and define replay-compatible Worker deployment for missions that outlive a single software release.
acceptance_criteria: Carry-over state contains only mission/revision/epoch/checkpoint/work-item/control identities and bounded counters.
Workflow rolls over at configurable safe-boundary thresholds or Temporal recommendation, never mid-mutation.
Search attributes/static details preserve logical mission discoverability across the run chain and domain audit retains history beyond Temporal visibility retention.
Workflow code changes use an explicit patch/build-version/replay policy with tests for the pinned Temporal SDK.
validation_method: Historical replay against previous Workflow version
definition_of_done: A logical mission crosses at least three continue-as-new runs and a Worker replacement without losing state or replaying accepted mutations.
review_notes: Current namespace creation uses seven-day retention; mission audit/history must not depend exclusively on closed Temporal visibility records.

items.title: Mission operation journal and authoritative recovery reconstruction
items.description: Extend idempotent mutation reservations to commands, installs, services, model lifecycle, Git integration, checkpoints, and revision/epoch transitions, then reconstruct safe mission state after restart.
acceptance_criteria: Every side-effecting operation has a stable idempotency key, request digest, lifecycle, result/evidence digest, and reconciliation policy.
Recovery determines active revision/epoch/task, last committed checkpoint, Git authority, model lease, required services, and replay safety from persisted state.
Unknown completion is reconciled against actual state before retry and accepted work is never duplicated.
Recovery disposition and all decisions are persisted/audited.
validation_method: Kill-point fault injection before/during/after each mutation class
definition_of_done: Restart at every tested mutation boundary produces one authoritative result and no duplicate accepted commit, install, or service action.
review_notes: Current workflow_mutations allows only provider_call, worktree, and github; extend it with typed operation classes rather than arbitrary strings.

items.title: Mission epoch branch and worktree manager
items.description: Extend the sole AgentFactory worktree authority with deterministic autonomous/<mission>/epoch-<n> branches and epoch worktrees rooted at exact base commits.
acceptance_criteria: Branch/path identity is normalized, collision-safe, workspace-contained, and persisted before Git mutation.
Epoch 1 starts from the approved repository base and later epochs may start from any valid checkpoint commit.
Existing divergent or dirty branches/worktrees fail closed and reconcile without destructive adoption.
Prior epoch branches remain preserved and standard task worktrees remain compatible.
definition_of_done: Two epochs coexist from different base checkpoints with intact branches and auditable authority.
review_notes: Never use reset --hard on main or a prior epoch branch.

items.title: Per-item worktree and autonomous local integration path
items.description: Base item worktrees on the active epoch head and integrate only fully accepted candidate commits into that epoch branch with fencing and idempotency.
acceptance_criteria: Each logical item attempt records base SHA, item branch/worktree, candidate commit, validation/review evidence, and integration result.
A stale lease or superseded epoch cannot commit or integrate.
Integration is idempotent and detects non-fast-forward/conflict state without rewriting history.
Push, PR creation, protected-branch merge, and main-branch mutation remain outside default autonomous authority.
definition_of_done: An accepted item commit appears exactly once on the active epoch branch and no unauthorized ref changes occur.

items.title: Checkpoint materialization, validation, and epoch restart service
items.description: Create required checkpoints at mission milestones and restore a new epoch worktree from a validated historical checkpoint commit and manifests.
acceptance_criteria: Automatic checkpoints cover backlog approval, bootstrap, architecture baseline, each completed item/accepted repair/revision/integration milestone, and final validation.
Creation is idempotent per milestone identity and binds the exact active revision/epoch/Git/manifests/evidence state.
Restart verifies checkpoint digest, commit reachability, artifacts, and environment manifest before creating a new epoch.
Later checkpoints remain visible and are marked superseded only in derived status.
definition_of_done: Restarting from checkpoint 2 after checkpoints 3-4 creates epoch 2 at the exact checkpoint-2 state and preserves all epoch-1 records.

items.title: Apply Backlog Changes - Restart domain service
items.description: Apply an explicitly authorized human revision at a selected checkpoint, recalculate dependencies/impact, create a new epoch, and return invalidated work to execution.
acceptance_criteria: Command binds actor, revision/digest, expected active state, selected checkpoint, and idempotency key.
Impact classifications and dependency recalculation complete before the epoch becomes active.
Invalidated completed items become pending in the new active projection while prior completion/evidence remains historical.
A material agent revision cannot use this human-authorized path without explicit human apply/approval.
definition_of_done: A user-edited revision restarts from a selected checkpoint and autonomously schedules only new/stale/affected ready work.

items.title: Installed local model inventory and role selection
items.description: Discover installed models through qualified LOCAL providers and resolve single- or multi-model role assignments without hardcoding Ollama into mission logic.
acceptance_criteria: Inventory records provider/model identity, version/tag, capabilities, health, resource hints, and discovery timestamp.
Role resolution supports default_model plus overrides and rejects missing/unhealthy/remote assignments.
Resolved assignments are versioned and checkpointed.
Inventory refresh cannot silently replace an approved assignment or policy.
definition_of_done: A mission with one installed local model receives valid isolated assignments for every required role.

items.title: Durable global local-inference scheduler
items.description: Serialize local inference across missions with a fair persistent queue, capacity configuration, fenced leases, heartbeat, release/cancel, and orphan recovery.
acceptance_criteria: Default max_concurrent_local_llm is 1 for the configured inference pool across all missions.
Lease contains mission/epoch/task/role/provider/model/request identity and fencing token; stale holders cannot report accepted results.
Queue order/fairness is deterministic and pause/stop/cancel releases or withdraws work safely.
Worker/process restart reconciles orphan leases and never permits overlapping capacity.
definition_of_done: Stress tests prove maximum observed local inference concurrency never exceeds configured capacity before and after restart.
review_notes: Do not implement this as an in-process semaphore.

items.title: Ollama dynamic model and lifecycle adapter
items.description: Qualify Ollama as the first LOCAL transport with dynamic per-request model selection, structured output/tool capability reporting, health, usage, and verified model load/release behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Model selection comes from the authorized role assignment rather than a fixed provider argument vector.
Adapter reports actual model identity, tokens/duration when available, and bounded output/error evidence.
Scheduler-directed release/unload is attempted and verified according to qualified capability; unsupported behavior is explicit.
Cancellation terminates the invocation/process tree and releases the scheduler lease safely.
definition_of_done: Two configured Ollama models can execute sequential roles through one lane without hardcoded workflow logic or overlapping leases.
review_notes: Choose the qualified Ollama transport behind the provider contract; do not bake a transport endpoint into AutonomousMissionWorkflow.

items.title: Writable local LLM Worker Runtime through Tool Gateway
items.description: Add a provider-neutral local worker loop that validates structured model turns and invokes only authorized AgentFactory tools inside the fenced mission worktree.
acceptance_criteria: Local model output cannot directly execute shell or mutate files; all actions pass typed Tool Gateway schemas and mission/role/policy allowlist intersection.
Runtime supports read/edit, bounded command/build/test, Git status/diff, and approved environment/service operations with complete evidence.
Every turn and tool result is bounded, content-addressed, cancellation-aware, and tied to context/authorization/scheduler/fencing identity.
A mutable action closes unsafe fallback and stale authorization/lease is rejected before each tool call.
definition_of_done: A fake local model modifies and tests a scoped file through tools while every attempted out-of-scope action fails closed and is audited.
review_notes: The current Ollama CLI provider is advisory; this runtime is the critical path for actual autonomous implementation.

items.title: Fresh isolated role contexts and mission memory integration
items.description: Construct each analyst/architect/developer/tester/reviewer/integrator invocation from authoritative targeted sources and update concise typed mission memory after meaningful progress.
acceptance_criteria: Context order follows specification, backlog, architecture/ADRs, item/dependencies, relevant code/evidence/memory, then role instructions.
Each invocation has a new context package/session digest and excludes unrelated/full repository history.
Memory retains architecture, decisions, completed work, limitations, debt, failures, topology, versions, tests, active revision, and next tasks with provenance/invalidation.
Mandatory authoritative/safety sources cannot be compacted away.
definition_of_done: Two roles using the same model receive distinct bounded packages and can reconstruct necessary project state without prior conversation history.

items.title: MODEL_INDEPENDENT and LOGICALLY_INDEPENDENT review routing
items.description: Preserve model-independent review when available and add an explicit same-model isolated-context fallback for Autonomous Local missions.
acceptance_criteria: Reviewer routing first selects an eligible different model and records MODEL_INDEPENDENT.
When no second model exists, a distinct reviewer role/agent with a fresh package/session may record LOGICALLY_INDEPENDENT without producer transcript access.
Evidence records producer/reviewer identities, model, context digests, selection rationale, independence class, and exceptions.
The fallback is opt-in to Autonomous Local and standard review exclusion remains unchanged.
definition_of_done: A one-model mission completes review with honest logical-independence evidence while an equivalent standard run still rejects same-model review.

items.title: Autonomous Local telemetry and non-monetary safety policy
items.description: Keep usage telemetry while making cumulative monetary/token budgets observational for approved local inference and retaining bounded strategy/tool/runtime protections.
acceptance_criteria: Autonomous Local traces record tokens, inference duration, provider/model/GPU metadata, tool calls, attempts, and elapsed mission time.
Cost/token totals do not reserve, pause, or block approved local stages; standard traces keep existing enforcement.
Technical context/output/time/disk/tool-risk and per-strategy repair bounds remain enforced and separately named.
Dashboard/read models can distinguish observational usage from enforced safety limits.
definition_of_done: An Autonomous Local run exceeds configured cost/token budget values and continues, while the identical standard run is blocked as before.

items.title: Required-vs-current environment discovery artifact
items.description: Inventory the host and derive project requirements from the approved architecture/backlog as a versioned, machine-readable comparison.
acceptance_criteria: Discovery covers OS, CPU, RAM, GPU, storage, runtimes, SDKs, package managers, Docker, Git, local model runtime/models, dependencies, databases, services, ports, build/test tools, and versions/health.
Required environment is traced to approved backlog/architecture items and distinguishes required, optional, present, missing, unhealthy, and incompatible.
Host-sensitive data is stored as bounded AgentFactory evidence, not automatically committed to the target repository.
Discovery is read-only, idempotent, and refreshable after recovery.
definition_of_done: A fixture host yields a complete reproducible plan input with every required component classified and traced.

items.title: Versioned environment and service manifests
items.description: Maintain durable versioned environment-manifest and service-manifest records that combine intended state, observed state, versions, ports, containers, dependencies, and health checks.
acceptance_criteria: Typed schema covers tools, runtimes, services, ports, models, containers, dependencies, health checks, provenance, and observation time.
Manifest versions are immutable/content-addressed and checkpoints reference exact versions.
Planner/executor consults both manifest and actual state before mutation and detects drift.
Secrets and raw credentials never enter manifests.
definition_of_done: Healthy replay creates no duplicate manifest/mutation and drift produces a new observed version with explicit reconciliation needs.

items.title: Policy-bound bootstrap planner and idempotent executor
items.description: Generate and execute a typed bootstrap DAG using project-local/user-level/container operations, a strict tool policy, operation journal, and postcondition/health verification.
acceptance_criteria: Plan supports required venv/package/project directories/config/migrations/containers/models/services/ports/health operations with dependencies and rollback/reconcile policy.
Each operation is allowlisted, bounded, non-interactive, scoped, idempotent, and authorized by the approved bootstrap/tool profile.
Success requires version/postcondition and health verification, not exit code alone; healthy components are skipped.
Commands, sanitized output, exit code, version, health, files/services changed, and attempt identity are persisted.
definition_of_done: Running an approved plan twice converges to the same healthy environment with no duplicate install/service side effects.
review_notes: Prefer typed operations to arbitrary model-authored shell scripts.

items.title: Environment health convergence, service recovery, and NEEDS_HUMAN_ACTION
items.description: Check required services before development/resume, restart safe project services, and classify unavoidable interactive/physical blockers without silent failure.
acceptance_criteria: Health phase reports Temporal, PostgreSQL, Ollama, Docker, project databases/APIs, ports, and configured services with explicit states.
Authorized restart actions are journaled, bounded, verified, and retried by distinct recovery policy before development resumes.
UAC/interactive authentication/missing physical resource/unsupported installation becomes durable NEEDS_HUMAN_ACTION with exact operator instruction and resumable state.
Unhealthy orchestration prerequisites block mission Activities rather than being misreported as project bootstrap work.
definition_of_done: After simulated host restart, missing safe services recover and the mission resumes; an unavoidable interactive blocker waits durably and resumes after verified remediation.

items.title: Windows local long-run profile and orchestration preflight
items.description: Document and support safe startup/recovery of Temporal Compose, AgentFactory Worker/backend, and applicable local model runtime after Windows reboot.
acceptance_criteria: Preflight clearly separates orchestration prerequisites from project bootstrap and blocks mission start until Temporal/Worker/backend are healthy.
Opt-in startup profile uses reviewed commands, least privilege, stable paths, logs, ordering, and health verification.
Normal stop/start preserves named Temporal/PostgreSQL volumes and never invokes reset/destroy operations.
Install/remove/status/troubleshooting procedures are documented and reversible.
definition_of_done: A reboot/start exercise restores the same running mission and Temporal data without manual console approval or volume reset.

items.title: Active-revision ready selector and technical subtask creation
items.description: Select the next deterministic ready task from the active revision and allow scoped agent-created technical subtasks without silently changing product scope.
acceptance_criteria: Only active-revision executable tasks with satisfied dependencies and READY status are selected in deterministic priority/order.
Epic/feature containers, stale/removed/blocked/running/done items are never dispatched.
Technical subtasks inherit trace, scope, authorization, acceptance/validation fields, and dependencies from an approved parent.
Potential material product change creates an AGENT_MATERIAL proposed revision and pauses scope-changing execution.
definition_of_done: A mixed revision schedules every eligible task once in deterministic order and never auto-executes a material scope change.

items.title: Autonomous work-item coding-delivery integration
items.description: Adapt the existing context, planning, coding, candidate, validation, review, repair, and integration services into the opt-in autonomous child-job loop.
acceptance_criteria: One scoped item flows through collect context, plan, implement, build/test, deterministic validation, review, repair if needed, and local epoch integration.
Every acceptance criterion maps to primary validation evidence and review verdict before DONE.
Child job resolves autonomous mission authority instead of per-call/provider/Founder gates but cannot widen tools/repository/ref scope.
Successful integration records commit, files, commands, tests, reviewer/model/independence, attempts, and artifacts.
definition_of_done: A local fake/model worker implements a failing-then-repaired task and the parent sees one accepted commit and DONE item without a per-call gate.

items.title: Bounded autonomous repair and strategy escalation chain
items.description: Replace repeated identical retry with persisted strategy-level escalation through repair, review, replan, alternatives, model switch, task split, and architecture revisit before NEEDS_ATTENTION.
acceptance_criteria: Each attempt records strategy, failure signature, evidence, model/role/context, outcome, and why the next strategy differs.
Per-strategy attempts are bounded and the same failure/strategy pair cannot loop indefinitely.
Available recovery sequence includes repair, reviewer diagnosis, replan, alternative implementation, model switch, task decomposition, and architecture revisit subject to capability/scope.
Only exhausted applicable strategies produce durable resumable NEEDS_ATTENTION.
definition_of_done: A controlled persistent failure traverses all applicable distinct strategies exactly as configured and stops resumably without token/cost authorization.

items.title: Architecture evolution, ADR propagation, and scope guard
items.description: Allow evidence-driven implementation architecture changes while routing material product-scope changes to a proposed backlog revision.
acceptance_criteria: Minor technical architecture changes create/update versioned architecture evidence and ADRs with alternatives, consequences, affected contracts, and validation.
Deterministic policy plus structured rationale classifies product-scope impact and records uncertainty.
Material change creates an AGENT_MATERIAL proposed revision and WAITING_FOR_BACKLOG_APPROVAL; no affected implementation continues under old authority.
Architecture/checkpoint/context/memory references update atomically or roll back.
definition_of_done: A technical refactor proceeds with an ADR, while a product behavior change stops for exact revision approval and preserves prior architecture.
review_notes: Reuse existing ADR mechanisms but do not silently apply their standard human architecture-approval semantics to autonomous minor changes without an explicit mode policy.

items.title: Accepted-work checkpoint and mission-memory progression
items.description: After accepted integration, atomically mark the active item DONE, update concise memory/architecture/test state, and create the next reconstructible checkpoint.
acceptance_criteria: DONE is projected only after accepted evidence and epoch integration commit are authoritative.
Checkpoint records completed/pending items, commit/ref/worktree, architecture/environment/role/memory/service/validation versions and relevant artifacts.
Memory update is concise, typed, provenance-linked, and invalidates contradicted state without deleting history.
Crash between integration, item completion, memory, and checkpoint reconciles to one logical accepted result.
definition_of_done: Repeated recovery after every injected boundary yields one DONE item, one integrated commit, and one logical checkpoint.

items.title: Final mission validation and COMPLETED transition
items.description: When no executable active-revision item remains, validate the complete project, backlog, architecture, environment, repository, checkpoints, and audit bundle before terminal completion.
acceptance_criteria: All active tasks are DONE or explicitly non-executable by approved revision state and every acceptance criterion has accepted evidence.
Final validators, integration health, repository cleanliness/ref authority, service health, checkpoint integrity, and audit continuity pass.
Failure returns to repair/replan or NEEDS_ATTENTION according to remaining strategies rather than marking complete.
COMPLETED creates the final checkpoint/evidence index and schedules no further autonomous work.
definition_of_done: A completed mission exposes the epoch branch repository, active backlog, validation, architecture, manifests, checkpoints, and full audit with no pending work.

items.title: Autonomous Mission application service and persisted projections
items.description: Add transport-neutral typed commands/read models for missions, proposals, active backlog, epochs, checkpoints, environment, controls, and persisted agent activity.
acceptance_criteria: Service exposes every logical operation in specification sections 30-35 without importing FastAPI or invoking CLI subprocesses.
Status/progress use active revision/epoch and combine bounded Temporal live state with persisted domain fallback.
Activity timeline projects persisted model/role/context/tool/validation/review/commit/checkpoint evidence, not frontend logs.
Commands require actor, idempotency key, expected state/version, and create audit records.
definition_of_done: CLI and web can be implemented as thin adapters over one complete application boundary.

items.title: Autonomous Mission REST API
items.description: Expose create/specification/analyze/backlog/approve/start/status/control/checkpoint/restart/revision/activity/environment operations through existing REST conventions.
acceptance_criteria: Routes cover every required logical API operation with typed request/response/error models and bounded pagination.
Authentication/tenant ownership, idempotency, ETag/expected version, confirmation rules, and audit match existing API boundaries.
Signal-producing routes first commit/validate the domain command, then deliver Temporal control idempotently.
Unavailable Temporal/provider/environment state is explicit and never shown as success.
definition_of_done: Every mission command is available through REST without duplicated business logic and produces the same receipt on idempotent retry.

items.title: Autonomous Mission CLI command group
items.description: Add create, analyze, backlog, approve, start, status, pause, resume/continue, stop, checkpoints, restart, revision, activity, and environment commands over the shared service.
acceptance_criteria: Commands follow existing parser/output/exit-code/workspace/database conventions and support machine-readable output where established.
Mutations require explicit actor/confirmation/idempotency/expected state inputs according to application policy.
CLI and direct-service tests produce equivalent final state and ordered audit event types.
Existing commands and help remain compatible.
required_infrastructure: Temporal test server for control tests
definition_of_done: The full mission lifecycle, including historical checkpoint restart, can be operated headlessly through shared services.

items.title: Control Center mission creation, planning, approval, status, and controls
items.description: Add an Autonomous Missions navigation section with pre-approval planning screens and live mission status/controls backed by persisted/application state.
acceptance_criteria: Pre-approval view shows specification, architecture summary, generated backlog, roles/models, exact digest, Approve Backlog - Start Mission, and Regenerate Backlog.
Running view shows name/state/phase/disposition/epoch/revision/runtime/task/role/model/activity/progress/checkpoint/environment health.
Pause, resume, stop/continue, retry, and restart controls display exact confirmation impact and durable receipts.
Loading/empty/stale/disconnected/error states are accessible and never resemble success.
definition_of_done: An operator creates, plans, approves, pauses, resumes, stops, and continues a mission without using a separate business-logic path.

items.title: Control Center backlog editor, checkpoints, architecture, environment, and activity
items.description: Provide the detailed active backlog/revision editor and chronological checkpoint/activity/architecture/environment evidence views with apply-and-restart flows.
acceptance_criteria: Backlog displays hierarchy, status, priority, dependencies, criteria, role, attempts, validation, commit, checkpoint, and active-revision-only progress; edits create a new revision.
Checkpoint timeline displays timestamp/reason/commit/completed state/architecture/epoch and explains that Restart from here preserves later history but creates a new epoch.
Activity timeline is rendered from persisted evidence with role/model/action/validation/review/repair/commit/checkpoint entries.
Architecture/ADR, environment/service manifests, health, logs/evidence links, and Apply Backlog Changes - Restart are available with accessible responsive states.
definition_of_done: A user edits a backlog, selects a historical checkpoint, applies/restarts, and observes the new epoch plus preserved prior history entirely through persisted UI state.

items.title: Domain migration, authorization, compatibility, and security qualification
items.description: Build the negative and upgrade test foundation proving Autonomous Mission is opt-in and cannot weaken existing authority, isolation, or provider protections.
acceptance_criteria: Fresh and every supported historical schema upgrade preserves records, approvals, artifacts, events, audit chain, and standard behavior.
Remote/missing-location provider, unrelated mission/task/ref/tool, stale revision/epoch/lease, revoked policy, and pre-approval mutation are denied and audited.
Standard provider/Founder/GitHub gates and monetary/token budgets remain enforced exactly as before.
Path traversal, prompt/tool injection, secret leakage, arbitrary network, global install, protected Git ref, and cross-tenant attempts fail closed.
definition_of_done: All old tests pass unchanged and the new negative matrix proves no autonomous authority can escape its exact local mission scope.

items.title: Temporal, local-runtime, environment, and end-to-end mission qualification
items.description: Prove the complete mission using deterministic/fake local providers in CI and an opt-in real Ollama/Temporal/Docker profile.
acceptance_criteria: CI scenario creates a mission from text, generates backlog, waits, approves once, bootstraps, repairs a failure, completes multiple tasks, commits/checkpoints, and reaches COMPLETED.
Scenario covers single-model logical review and a multi-model one-lane serialization fixture.
Pause/resume, stop/continue, retry, checkpoint restart, and backlog-change restart are exercised with no duplicate accepted work.
Opt-in profile validates real Temporal Compose durability, Ollama local inference, Docker/project services, and UI/CLI parity.
validation_method: Control Center and CLI application parity
definition_of_done: The specification's end-to-end scenario passes deterministically and the real local profile has reproducible opt-in evidence.

items.title: Fault/reboot soak, resource-growth gate, documentation, and release evidence
items.description: Qualify months-long design assumptions through accelerated and opt-in soak/fault exercises, then publish configuration, startup, recovery, upgrade, rollback, and operator documentation.
acceptance_criteria: Fault matrix covers AgentFactory backend/Worker, Temporal Server/PostgreSQL, Docker, Windows/host, Ollama/model, build/test process, and project service interruption.
Accelerated continue-as-new/recovery tests and an opt-in long soak show no lost/duplicate accepted work and bounded history, memory, database, logs, worktrees, containers, and model leases.
Upgrade/replay and rollback preserve active mission authorization, revision, epoch, checkpoint, evidence, and audit continuity.

Docs cover configuration, local execution/tool policy, planning/approval, controls, revisions/checkpoints, autostart, recovery, security boundary, troubleshooting, and clean uninstall without volume destruction.
definition_of_done: All release gates in docs/autonomous-mission-mode-review.md pass and a designated human operator accepts the reproducible evidence bundle.
